text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, which allows a computer to identify what is in a picture, such as a cat or a car. Object detection goes further by finding where objects are located in an image. These technologies have many applications in everyday life. For example, self-driving cars use computer vision to recognise roads, traffic signs, and pedestrians. This helps them drive safely without a human driver. Computer vision is also used in security cameras, medical images, and smartphones. As technology improves, it will become even more useful in the future.
